note: Hob the shopkeeper. Trees are data: nodes {text, choices[{text, goto, if}], effects, end}. text may be a string, an array (one is picked, none repeated within the last five) or a bark token $greeting / $farewell / $idle. A choice with goto 'end' or no goto ends the talk. Conditions: min_rep [points], rank [Stranger, Known, Friend, Trusted: this rank or better] (data/npcs/reputation.json), flag, flag_not, hour_between [from, to], has_item [id, n], can_train [skill, max_level, item, n] (item and n optional). Effects: open_shop (opens the NPC's shop from data/npcs/shops.json), add_rep [points], set_flag, clear_flag, give_item [id, n], take_item [id, n], train_skill [skill, max_level, item, n]. roots: the first whose condition holds starts the talk. Lines keep to short sentences (12 words) for the voice.

Have a look. I buy and sell.

quest_offer.text: My hearth is cold. Bring me three bolts of firewood.

quest_reminder.text: Three bolts of firewood, split. I am grateful.

quest_done.text: Splendid! Take this for your trouble: two roast meals and five copper.

teach.text: Three stones for the lesson. Now count with me.

quest2_offer.text: Since you ask: bring me four logs. I will pay three bronze.

quest2_done.text: Fine logs. Three bronze, as I said. You are a help.

quest2_reminder.text: Four logs, and the pay is three bronze.

friend_gift.text: You have been good to me. Take this knife, it was my father's.
